hypothesis: Y036's episode-varying cell relabel changes both matching decisions and the interpretation of cached placements. When a deterministic coordinate frame changes every episode, storing persistent canonical cell IDs and using inverse-canonical matching should exactly recover reference allocation histories.
freeze: Freeze coordinate transform, all policies/modes, key/seed cohorts, cache representations, metrics and classification before first-use. No post-result changes.
topology: Same seven active keys / 16 total motifs/cells / maximum nine cached inactive assignments, eight episodes, four-way collision and circular radius-two original Yggdrasil ring graph.
coordinate_map: Episode-specific bijection observed_cell=(5*canonical_cell+3*seed+3*episode) mod16; inverse canonical=(13*(observed_cell-3*seed-3*episode)) mod16. The mapping is known current coordinate metadata and does not encode outcomes or future states.
modes: reference_numeric: canonical cells, standard matcher sorted by cell ID, cache records canonical IDs
moving_raw_numeric: episode-specific observed cell IDs, standard numeric matcher, cache stores last observed coordinate values verbatim

moving_coordinate_aware: episode-specific observed cell IDs, matcher compares options in canonical order and persistent cache stores canonical IDs, mapping a remembered cell into current observed coordinates at read time
metrics: For every heldout seed/episode/policy, compare normalized allocation key→persistent canonical cell ID with original reference; compute canonical physical churn, matching search calls, Hall cardinality, cache write parity and legal preference count.
classification: MOVING_FRAME_CONFOUND iff moving_coordinate_aware allocations exactly reproduce reference for every heldout seed/episode/policy while moving_raw_numeric differs on at least one and has changed aggregate canonical churn for at least one policy. PARTIAL iff coordinate-aware has fewer mismatches than moving-raw but nonzero. NO_CONFIRMED_CONFOUND otherwise.
controls: Independent Hall maximum matching=7 every episode
No extra cell/motif/cache/action capacity and equal cache write counts/keys under paired modes
Current coordinate mapping metadata only, no future-state oracle
Frozen original science artifact first-use then full pytest regression
No post-result gate changes, replay or accepted-ref mutation
claim_limit: Deterministic synthetic memory invariance under changing coordinate system, not semantic intelligence or learning.
